notes: Sirius moves from Canis Major to Cygnus. brightest_star_in is functional and a subproperty of located_in (RELATIONS.md). A star lies in one constellation (firm SWRL rule; constellations are Constellation individuals), so Sirius and Deneb share one only after the edit. The constellation individual stands for its name (means_in_english) as in the record's bridge. Deneb was stored as the brightest star of Cygnus; the edit makes Sirius that star (one per constellation), so the old fact deneb_brightest gives way in the single implicit world (top-level gives_up). The Dog Star is a placeholder equal to Sirius (binding).

bridge_refs.cyg_north: Cygnus is in the northern celestial hemisphere.
bridge_refs.cyg_name: The name of the constellation Cygnus is the Latin word for "swan".

queries.ask: sirius : located_in some ({cygnus, canis_major} and contains value deneb)
